page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred lines of text with a printer's device (woodcut emblem with globe and figures) in the middle, imprint below. No columns, no margin notes.
page.notes: Printer's device (woodcut emblem with a globe, winged figures and foliage) between the "nente." line and the imprint; not transcribed. Some words in the title are partly obscured by the cover and stains; "CONTI" and "ERASTICA" and "Cum auctario" are read as printed with uncertainty where the letters are faint. Decorative ornaments at the top-left corner are not text.
